title: Ex-Basketball Wives' Cast Member Jennifer Williams Reacts To Ex-Husband Eric Williams Being Engaged
htmlContent:
According to The Neighborhood Talk, former NBA veteran Eric Williams has recently reengaged and become a farmer.

Suppose you are not familiar with Williams for his playing career. In that case, you might be familiar with his appearances on Basketball Wives in the early 2010s with his ex-wife Jennifer Williams and his knot.

Williams also played for 12 seasons in the NBA with stops with seven teams, which includes the Boston Celtics, San Antonio Spurs, and Toronto Raptors.

Of course, he is famous for throwing a drink in Jennifer's face and walking out of the restaurant, but according to Williams in an interview with The Breakfast Club, he threw the drink in her face because she disrespected his mother.

"You know damn well why I throw a drink in her face like that... Angela Yee, just because you know this is a violation because of that conversation between my mother and her before the wedding," said Williams.

"She is supposed to wear that to the grave. No one is supposed to know about that conversation but the world because she put it in [Sister 2 Sister] Magazine. And She has been talking about in every interview that she been doing."

Back to Williams's engagement, his ex-wife Jennifer Williams caught wind of the news from The Neighborhood Talk and commented in the comment section on Instagram.

She replied, 'Congrats.'

We wish the happy couple all the best with their future endeavors.
